notes: Blind classification completed from the entire packet before reading the current card. The two role selectors instantiate one mechanism; scoring and return-based updating are merged. The memory-free reference shows the trading workflow is separable from memory mechanisms. Only decision_support is assigned: return-forecasting baselines are excluded. Hit rate supplies task-output accuracy evidence; return, Sharpe and drawdown supply decision utility. Process validity is not established by runtime success/failure measurements; illustrative trading cases and parsing fallback rules are not treated as a process-validation evaluation. Cutoff and preprocessing protocols are evidence for temporal validity, not independently claimed general-purpose modules.
